name: Loomly
description: Loomly is a social media management platform for planning, collaborating on, scheduling, publishing, engaging with, and analyzing social content.
agentUseSummary: Preview Loomly's product scope. Connect and agent actions remain unavailable because Loomly publishes no customer API or approved third-party developer contract for Relay.

capabilities.label: Manage social content
capabilities.description: Preview the product capability that could be implemented only after Loomly publishes or explicitly approves a customer API contract.

blocked.label: Connect without a Loomly API contract
blocked.description: Loomly publishes product-managed integrations but no customer API or approved third-party developer contract for Relay.

blocked.label: Use private APIs or browser sessions
blocked.description: Passwords, cookies, sessions, traffic capture, undocumented endpoints, reverse engineering, scraping, and interface automation are blocked.

blocked.label: Access Loomly account or content data
blocked.description: Calendars, collaborators, social accounts, posts, media, comments, messages, analytics, and identity data are unavailable without an authorized API contract.

blocked.label: Publish or administer Loomly
blocked.description: Creating or scheduling posts, publishing, replying, changing workflows, integrations, teams, subscriptions, or administration is unavailable without an authorized API contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider contract required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until Loomly publishes or explicitly approves a customer API and authentication contract for Relay.

runtimeSupport.description: Loomly is visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable without a provider-approved API contract.
Loomly is visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable without a provider-approved API contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Loomly publishes no customer-facing account API or approved third-party developer and authentication contract for Relay. Its public status-page API exposes service health only and cannot authorize customer account access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Wait for Loomly to publish or explicitly approve a complete customer API, authentication, permissions, rate-limit, revocation, and integration contract before adding credentials or runtime tools.

evidence.supports: Current first-party integration catalog lists product-managed social, workflow, and content integrations, including Zapier, but publishes no customer API or developer program.
Official Loomly automation access is presented through the provider-managed Zapier connection and its fixed triggers/actions, not a public customer developer API.
Current terms prohibit reverse engineering, deriving source code, automated or manual extraction and scraping, and bypassing service security or protections.
The separately published Status API exposes operational status components and notices only; it is not an account, calendar, content, publishing, analytics, or administration API.

securityNotes: Relay does not accept Loomly usernames, passwords, cookies, sessions, Zapier authorization, social-network tokens, or any other credential.
Relay does not call undocumented Loomly endpoints, capture traffic, scrape the service, automate the browser, reverse engineer the application, or bypass provider controls.
The public status-page API is not repurposed as a Loomly customer connector because it contains only service-health information and grants no account authority.
Calendars, collaborators, social accounts, posts, media, comments, messages, analytics, publishing, workflows, integrations, billing, and administration remain unavailable.
A future connector requires a first-party or explicitly approved API and authentication contract with documented permissions, rates, revocation, privacy, and customer authorization.
